Meta-Analysis of Diagnostic and Prognostic Studies with Sensitivity Analysis for Publication Bias on the SROC and Time-Dependent SROC Curves

Source: R/DiagProgMeta-package.R
DiagProgMeta-package.Rd

This package implements the meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy (DTA) studies and prognostic studies by the summary receiver operating characteristic (SROC) curve and the area under the SROC curve (SAUC), together with the likelihood-based sensitivity analysis for publication bias.

  • Diagnostic studies: the bivariate random-effects model of the logit-transformed sensitivity and specificity (Reitsma et al., 2005) doi:10.1016/j.jclinepi.2005.02.022 , and the sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the SROC curve and SAUC (Zhou et al., 2023) doi:10.1002/sim.9643 .

  • Prognostic studies: the time-dependent SROC curve and SAUC, where the time-dependent sensitivity and specificity are reconstructed from the published survival probabilities (Hattori and Zhou, 2016) doi:10.1002/sim.7029 and the sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the time-dependent SROC curve and SAUC (Zhou et al., 2025) doi:10.1017/rsm.2025.14 .

Fitting functions

Without publication biasSensitivity analysis for publication bias
Diagnostic studies (SROC)reitsma.srocsrocsa.t
Prognostic studies (time-dependent SROC)hattori.tsroctsrocsa.lrt

sauc calculates the SAUC and its confidence interval.

Methods for the results

  • Objects of class "sroc" (from reitsma.sroc and hattori.tsroc): print.sroc, summary.sroc (printed by print.summary.sroc), and plot.sroc.

  • Objects of class "srocsa" (from srocsa.t and tsrocsa.lrt): print.srocsa, summary.srocsa, and plot.srocsa.

For the time-dependent results, the plot methods draw one plot for each time point (press <Return> for the next in an interactive session), or all the time points in one panel (overlay = TRUE).

Example data

  • IVD, CD64: meta-analyses of diagnostic studies.

  • Ki67: meta-analysis of Ki-67 as a prognostic marker in early breast cancer.

References

Hattori S, Zhou XH (2016). Time-dependent summary receiver operating characteristics for meta-analysis of prognostic studies. Statistics in Medicine, 35(26), 4746–4763. doi:10.1002/sim.7029

Reitsma JB, Glas AS, Rutjes AW, Scholten RJ, Bossuyt PM, Zwinderman AH (2005). Bivariate analysis of sensitivity and specificity produces informative summary measures in diagnostic reviews. Journal of Clinical Epidemiology, 58(10), 982–990. doi:10.1016/j.jclinepi.2005.02.022

Zhou Y, Huang A, Hattori S (2023). A likelihood-based sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the summary receiver operating characteristic in meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy. Statistics in Medicine, 42(6), 781–798. doi:10.1002/sim.9643

Zhou Y, Huang A, Hattori S (2025). Sensitivity analysis for reporting bias on the time-dependent summary receiver operating characteristics curve in meta-analysis of prognosis studies with time-to-event outcomes. Research Synthesis Methods, 16(3), 528–549. doi:10.1017/rsm.2025.14
